research_question: How does air resistance affect projectile range?
hypothesis: Under the specified quadratic-drag model, increasing drag reduces projectile range.
methodology: Numerically integrate the same initial launch with RK4 for three drag coefficients, including a no-drag control. Compare ranges, check the no-drag analytical solution, and repeat integration at half the time step as a numerical diagnostic.
assumptions: All parameter values are illustrative assumptions, not measured data.
Flat ground, equal launch and impact heights, constant air density, no wind or spin.
limitations: This tests a numerical model, not a physical hypothesis in the laboratory.
Deterministic integrations are not independent experimental replications.
